instruction: A cluttered alchemist's laboratory: bubbling glass flasks and retorts glowing green and violet, a heavy cauldron over coals, shelves crammed with jars and specimens, hanging bundles of dried herbs, melted candles, an open grimoire on a lectern, and a glowing rune circle inlaid on the stone floor. Potion light flickers across brass instruments.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Alchemist's Laboratory. A cluttered alchemist's laboratory: bubbling glass flasks and retorts glowing green and violet, a heavy cauldron over coals, shelves crammed with jars and specimens, hanging bundles of dried herbs, melted candles, an open grimoire on a lectern, and a glowing rune circle inlaid on the stone floor. Potion light flickers across brass instruments. Style: fantasy candlelit. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
